'''GL-916''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sold various wares at a stand. He boasted the qualities of his products and was willing to reduce prices for the cost-conscious customer.

When [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] asked GL-916 about the missing [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], he replied that he knew nothing of his whereabouts and proceed to attempt to sell his merchandise to R2-D2.
